description: Source code for the TFDServer class implementation, including the xport class for transport handling, in the Thrift server module within the Zephyr environment.

classes.name: xport
classes.description: A virtual transport class handling socket communication with poll, read, write, and interrupt capabilities.

classes.name: TFDServer
classes.description: A server class managing socket acceptance, interruption, and lifecycle within the Thrift framework.

methods.name: read_virt
methods.description: Reads data from the transport, using poll to wait for data availability.

methods.name: write_virt
methods.description: Writes data to the transport, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupts the transport by writing to the event file descriptor.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the transport is open.

methods.name: acceptImpl
methods.description: Accepts incoming connections and creates a new transport instance.

methods.name: getSocketFD
methods.description: Returns the server socket file descriptor.
